1588   /** Collapses Parquet optional-group {value: X} wrappers so MarshallingSession receives unwrapped values for Optional properties. */
1589   private void collapseOptionalWrappers(Map<?,?> row, ClassMeta<?> elementType) {
1590      var bm = elementType.getBeanMeta();
1591      boolean hasOptional = bm.getProperties().values().stream().anyMatch(p -> p.getBeanInfo() != null && p.getBeanInfo().isOptional());
1592      if (!hasOptional)
1593         return;
1594      for (var pMeta : bm.getProperties().values()) {
1595         var name = pMeta.getName();
1596         var val = row.get(name);
1597         var propType = (ClassMeta<?>) pMeta.getBeanInfo();
1598         if (val == null)
1599            continue;
1600         if (propType.isOptional() && val instanceof Map<?,?> val2) {
1601            var elemType = propType.getElementType();
1602            boolean absent = isAbsentOptionalMap(val2, elemType);
1603            // Detect absent inner Optional: all-null map, empty map, or nested {value:{all-null}} structure.
1604            // Use null so MarshallingSession's null→Optional<Optional<X>> conversion produces Optional.of(Optional.empty()).
1605            if (absent) {
1606               ((Map<String,Object>)row).put(name, null);
1607            } else {
1608               var inner = val2.get("value");
1609               var collapsed = collapseOptionalValue(inner, elemType);
1610               ((Map<String,Object>)row).put(name, collapsed);
1611            }
1612         } else if (propType.isBean() && val instanceof Map<?,?> val2)
1613            collapseOptionalWrappers(val2, propType);
1614      }
1615   }
1616
1617   /**
1618    * Returns true if the map represents an absent Optional value that should be treated as null,
1619    * allowing MarshallingSession's null→Optional<Optional<X>> conversion to produce Optional.of(Optional.empty()).
1620    *
1621    * <p>Absent patterns:
1622    * <ul>
1623    *   <li>Empty map {}
1624    *   <li>Map whose values are all null (e.g. {value: null})
1625    *   <li>Map {value: M} where M is itself absent (recursively): handles Optional<Optional<X>>
1626    *   <li>Map {value: M} where M has all null leaves (bean group for absent inner type)
1627    * </ul>
1628    */
1629   private boolean isAbsentOptionalMap(Map<?,?> m, ClassMeta<?> elemType) {
1630      if (m.values().stream().allMatch(v -> v == null))
1631         return true;
1632      var inner = m.get("value");
1633      if (inner instanceof Map<?,?> inner2) {
1634         if (elemType.isOptional())
1635            return isAbsentOptionalMap(inner2, elemType.getElementType());
1636         // For bean (non-Optional) inner type: check if all nested leaf values are null (absent bean group)
1637         return allNullLeaves(inner2);
1638      }
1639      return false;
1640   }
1641
1642   /** Returns true if all leaf values in the nested map structure are null. */
1643   private boolean allNullLeaves(Object obj) {
1644      if (obj == null)
1645         return true;
1646      if (!(obj instanceof Map<?,?> obj2))
1647         return false;
1648      return obj2.values().stream().allMatch(this::allNullLeaves);
1649   }
1650
1651   /** Recursively unwraps {value: X} when target is Optional; collapses nested beans. */
1652   private Object collapseOptionalValue(Object val, ClassMeta<?> targetType) {
1653      if (targetType.isOptional() && val instanceof Map<?,?> val2) {
1654         if (isAbsentOptionalMap(val2, targetType))
1655            return null;  // Let MarshallingSession convert null to Optional.of(Optional.empty())
1656         return collapseOptionalValue(val2.get("value"), targetType.getElementType());
1657      }
1658      if (targetType.isBean() && val instanceof Map<?,?> val2) {
1659         collapseOptionalWrappers(val2, targetType);
1660         return val2;
1661      }
1662      return val;
1663   }

1665   private static void setByPath(Map<String,Object> target, String path, Object value) throws ParseException {
1666      var parts = path.split("\\.");
1667      if (parts.length == 1) {
1668         target.put(path, value);
1669         return;
1670      }
1671      Object current = target;
1672      for (int i = 0; i < parts.length - 1; i++) {
1673         var key = parts[i];
1674         var currentMap = (Map<?,?>) current;
1675         current = ((Map<String,Object>)currentMap).computeIfAbsent(key, k -> new JsonMap());
1676      }
1677      ((Map<String,Object>)current).put(parts[parts.length - 1], value);
1678   }

1680   /** Wraps Map in JsonMap when target expects JsonMap (e.g. bean with constructor A(JsonMap)). */
1681   private static Object prepareMapForBean(Object value, ClassMeta<?> type) {
1682      if (value == null)
1683         return value;
1684      if (value instanceof JsonMap)
1685         return value;
1686      if (value instanceof Map<?,?> value2 && !type.isMap())
1687         return new JsonMap(value2);
1688      return value;
1689   }

1691   /** Unwraps ValueHolder map {value: X} to X when target is scalar; else converts via MarshallingSession. */
1692   private Object unwrapValueHolder(Object row, ClassMeta<?> targetType) throws ParseException {
1693      if (!(row instanceof Map<?,?> row2))
1694         return convertToType(row, targetType);
1695      // Unwrap {value: X} when target is scalar (or Object) - allow maps with extra keys (e.g. _type)
1696      if (row2.containsKey("value") && (targetType.isObject()
1697         || (!targetType.isMap() && !targetType.isCollection() && !targetType.isArray()))) {
1698         var v = row2.get("value");
1699         if (targetType.isObject())
1700            return v;
1701         return convertToType(prepareMapForBean(v, targetType), targetType);
1702      }
1703      return convertToType(prepareMapForBean(row, targetType), targetType);
1704   }

1706   private Object toArray(List<Object> values, ClassMeta<?> componentType) throws ParseException {
1707      var ct = componentType.inner();
1708      var arr = Array.newInstance(ct, values.size());

1710         Array.set(arr, i, convertToType(values.get(i), componentType));
1711      return arr;
1712   }

1714   private Object toCollection(List<Object> values, ClassMeta<?> collectionType) throws ParseException {

1718         result = collectionType.canCreateNewInstance() ? (Collection<Object>)collectionType.newInstance() : null;
